title: Hydrogen abundance
method: Lunar Prospector neutron spectrometer hydrogen map (half-degree). Negative values (counting noise) are set to 0. Bilinear resampling of the 0.5° simple-cylindrical product (longitude wraps at ±180°). True footprint ~60–150 km: finer grids add no detail.
